merrav2.scope: The GEE asset is Climate Engine daily MERRA-2 fields and derived ET; NASA base-reanalysis citations are a family proxy.
merrav2.existing_native: No exact-scope public COG/Zarr mirror established; NASA source NetCDF collections require Earthdata access.
merrav2.next_step: Identify canonical source and processing for the daily Climate Engine bands; separate any new NASA-derived product from an exact mirror.

plastic.scope: Lebreton et al. 2017 model; Figshare v6, 40,760 river input locations worldwide, 2010 estimates. Not the different Meijer 2021 dataset.
plastic.source_license: CC-BY-4.0 confirmed by original Figshare API metadata
plastic.existing_native: No exact counterpart found in targeted Source Coop search or local indexed products; absence is not proven.
plastic.next_step: Prepare GeoParquet and PMTiles from the checksum-verified original archive, preserving estimates and units; validate outputs before publication.

terraclim.scope: GEE family is legacy CMIP5 +2C/+4C (1985-2015); current producer v1.1 uses CMIP6 and 1950-2025. Base TerraClimate citation counts do not measure exact-scenario usage.
terraclim.existing_native: Planetary Computer Zarr is historical TerraClimate, not these future scenarios. No exact future counterpart established.
terraclim.next_step: Prefer a clearly named v1.1 scenario publication after source verification; keep the legacy and current releases distinct.

isric.scope: SoilGrids 2.0 mean predictions in native-grid Icechunk/Zarr; quantiles, uncertainty and WRB class probabilities not included.
isric.next_step: Evaluate existing mean-prediction product for registry reuse; inspect missing components before proposing another publication.

hydrolakes.scope: Global v1.0 polygons and points; existing Folia identity covers the original product.
hydrolakes.existing_native: Official FGDB (763 MB) and shapefile (820 MB) ZIPs; no original native copy established in this review. WaterNet is a derived dataset, not a HydroLAKES mirror.
hydrolakes.license_note: Producer page states CC BY 4.0; technical document also requests permission for redistribution of the complete database in its original format. Clarify how that wording applies to the intended transformed publication; do not infer a blanket ban on derivatives.

grip.scope: GRIP4 global road network, seven regional partitions; existing Folia identity only covers Africa.
grip.source_size_description: Producer lists global FGDB ZIP at 2.2 GB.
grip.existing_native: No exact GeoParquet/PMTiles/FlatGeobuf Source Coop copy established.
grip.license_note: PBL and Zenodo state CC0; reconcile differing catalog descriptions and preserve producer attribution.
